name: DynamicList
access: OML creates this object from a selector:DynamicList node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: el
properties.description: Selector. In OML the selector on the node is this element. Required.

properties.name: display
properties.description: Display object. See the Display entry. template, html, and css, or {bind: property} plus displays. Required.

properties.name: displays
properties.description: Map of display objects keyed by the bound property value. A display may contain nested OML. Optional.

properties.name: display_max
properties.description: Maximum items to display. Optional.

properties.name: chunks
properties.description: Chunk size. Requires scroll. The wiki example uses 200. Optional.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: single, multi, toggle, hit, static, or set. Defaults to single. Runtime constants SELECT_MODE_SINGLE, SELECT_MODE_MULTI, SELECT_MODE_TOGGLE, SELECT_MODE_HIT, SELECT_MODE_SET, and STATIC hold those strings. hit fires and returns data without selecting. set keeps a selected item selected. Optional.

properties.name: reselect
properties.description: In mode single, select fires again when the item is already selected. Optional.

properties.name: reorder
properties.description: Tap-hold-drag to reorder. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: swipe
properties.description: Items can be swiped. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: Triggers on rendering. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Property shared by every item, such as id. Recommended. Optional.

properties.name: as
properties.description: Keyword for scope targeting. Defaults to item. Optional.

properties.name: scope
properties.description: The list follows scope. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: list
properties.description: Items. Optional.

properties.name: selection
properties.description: Key values to select. Requires key. Optional.

properties.name: no_selection
properties.description: Describes items that cannot be selected. Optional.

properties.name: max_selection
properties.description: Maximum selected items. mode must be multi. Optional.

properties.name: shift_selection
properties.description: Shift selects a range. mode must be multi. Optional.

properties.name: filter_remove_selection
properties.description: Drops filtered-out items from the selection. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: callbacks
properties.description: select, unselect, and render. At runtime the same hooks are onSelect, onUnselect, and onRender. Optional.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the item array.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Sorts by a shared property. The wiki example uses 1 for ascending and -1 for descending.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Sets the key. Call it before passing a list.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an object or an array. An omitted index appends.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the display index. The item must be displayed.

methods.name: deleteSelection
methods.description: Deletes the selected items.

methods.name: findDelete
methods.description: Finds and deletes items and returns them. With key set, the property can be omitted: findDelete(10, 1). Without key: findDelete('id', 10, 1).

methods.name: findReplace
methods.description: Replaces the first match. Returns true or false.

methods.name: findUpdate
methods.description: Updates matches with a partial or complete object. Returns the number of updated items.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Index of the first object with that property and value.

methods.name: replaceAt
methods.description: Replaces the object at an index.

methods.name: refreshAt
methods.description: Renders the item at an index.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: HTML element of the first property and value match.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Adds matches to the selection and returns it. Single mode returns the object.

methods.name: unselect
methods.description: Removes a match from the selection.

methods.name: selectIndex
methods.description: Selects a display index.

methods.name: unselectIndex
methods.description: Unselects a display index.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Selected objects. Pass true to get the selected elements. Defaults to false. The wiki says the object form is an OGX.List.

methods.name: resetSelection
methods.description: Clears the selection.

methods.name: index
methods.description: With no argument, returns selectedIndex. With an index, selects that index.

methods.name: noSelection
methods.description: Sets, enables, or disables the no-selection option.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a sided item by property and value.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls to an item. Requires scroll. Added in 1.32.0.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the list.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SELECT
events.description: An item was selected. The event string is DynamicListSelect.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.UNSELECT
events.description: An item was unselected. The event string is DynamicListUnselect.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.BACK_HIT
events.description: A sided item's background was tapped. The event string is DynamicListBackHit.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SIDED
events.description: An item was set aside in SWIPE_MODE_SIDE. The event string is DynamicListSided. The payload has the side and the item.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.HOLD
events.description: A drag started after a tap-hold of about 2 seconds. The event string is DynamicListHold.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.RELEASE
events.description: Runtime constant beside HOLD. The event string is DynamicListRelease. The wiki events section does not describe it.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.DROP
events.description: A reorder drag ended. The event string is DynamicListDrop.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.RENDER
events.description: The list rendered. Also used to track filtering. The event string is DynamicListRender.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.READY
events.description: Fired once when the component is ready. The event string is DynamicListReady.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SELECT_FILTERED
events.description: The selection changed because of filtering. The event string is DynamicListSelectFiltered.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SELECT_UNFILTERED
events.description: The selection was reset because of filtering. The event string is DynamicListSelecUnfiltered.

catalog_status: Listed fields and methods are from the OGX.JS wiki or the runtime the test app loads. Members that are absent from this file are not to be invented.
